description: Load a scene in Godot 4.7 headless once and keep it running between calls, paused at frame 0, so godot_game can look at the live game and move it frame by frame without loading the world again (a big world can take a minute to load; godot_play loads it on every call). op `start` (scene: default the main scene; restart: true loads it again), `status`, or `stop`. Only this machine can reach it (a loopback port with a token), the project is not changed (the script lives in .godot/godotwright/), and the game quits by itself after `idle_minutes` without a request (default 15). Stop it when you are done.

idle_minutes.description: quit after this many minutes without a request (default 15)

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

restart.description: stop a running session and load the scene again

scene.description: the res:// scene to load (default: the main scene)

timeout_seconds.description: how long the scene may take to load (default 300)

name: godot_session
title: Start or stop a game session that stays up
